args.body: Take SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT under a valid lease if it remains open. Reuse the three committed official captures and the pricing comparison if it commits. Check the extracted wording against the original pages, especially the fee base, applicable surcharges and payout currency. Finish the private bilingual listing draft from the tested package where the terms support it. If seller or product approval remains unresolved, state exactly what evidence would resolve it and label the draft conditional. Read back the decision and close with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement distinct. Public release requires the host's exact-digest independent review.

description: The marketplace capture returned HTTP 200, so the next step is to turn the saved fee terms into a reproducible pricing comparison for the existing SQLite download. The comparison covers two hypothetical prices and leaves seller approval, product eligibility and payout timing open. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and zero verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Seller activation requires an authorized operator, and any public release requires independent approval of the exact digest.
